Add DELETE /api/items/{id} endpoint

Wires ItemService.delete_item through to the write repository's new
delete_item seam, and exposes it as DELETE /api/items/{id}: 204 when
the item is removed, 404 when the id doesn't exist.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add delete_item to the write item repository seam

Adds delete_item(item_id) -> bool to both the IWriteItemRepository
Protocol and the SQLAlchemy WriteItemRepository adapter, so item
deletion goes through the same repository seam as add/list — no SQL
outside the adapter.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add per-row delete control to the items list

Each row now has a Delete button that calls DELETE /api/items/{id}
and removes the row from local state on success, so the list updates
without a full page reload.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
